tex_content.html:
Lemma
[Second-derivative test at a local maximum]

If $\phi $ is continuous and locally maximal at $t_0$, differentiable near $t_0$, and $\phi '$ is differentiable at $t_0$, then $\phi ''(t_0)\le 0$.
Proof

\sketch

↗ lem:second-derivative-test-min Fermat’s lemma gives $\phi '(t_0)=0$. A positive second derivative would also make $t_0$ a local minimum; local constancy would then force $\phi ''(t_0)=0$.

□
